as_told.title: Obama on a podcast: 'aliens are real'

plain: A researcher and well known skeptic, Michael Shermer, says that former US President Barack Obama went on a podcast in the 2020s, was asked by the host whether he thought aliens were real, and answered, "Yeah, I think aliens are real." Shermer says this remark is what set off a large public release of government UFO files. A podcast host, Jesse Michels, tells the same story but frames Obama's comment as a way of provoking President Donald Trump. If so, a single offhand remark would have pushed the government to open its files.
